title: Understanding Caesura in Poetry
skills: identify internal pauses within poetic lines
analyze how caesura affects rhythm, pacing, and emphasis
explain how structural pauses contribute to tone and meaning
alignment_note: Explains caesura as an intentional pause within a poetic line and demonstrates how such pauses can affect rhythm, pacing, emphasis, tone, and meaning. Supports close reading, prosody, structural analysis, and interpretation of poetic craft across high school English courses.
